description: Offline-first, Ollama-like LLM runtime platform running GGUF models on CPU with token-level round-robin scheduler across PC and Android Termux

userStories.title: Model Storage and Directory Layout Management

acceptanceCriteria: Config directory ~/.llmhub created automatically on launch
Config file config.toml loaded with cross-platform default values
SQLite registry initialized with proper schemas
Termux environment paths and permissions correctly handled without requiring root

userStories.title: Hugging Face Model Downloader with Resume & Incremental SHA256
userStories.description: Download GGUF models from Hugging Face repositories with HTTP Range-based resume, progress bar, and streaming SHA-256 validation.
acceptanceCriteria: HTTP Range header resumption for interrupted downloads
Streaming SHA-256 calculation without second pass over multi-GB disk files
Atomic rename from .tmp to model.gguf upon verification
Storage in ~/.llmhub/models/<org>/<name>/<quant>/model.gguf with manifest.json

userStories.title: Standalone GGUF Header Parser & Metadata Extractor
userStories.description: Parse binary GGUF files directly without initializing full llama.cpp engine to read tensor counts, architecture, context length, KV heads, and chat templates.
acceptanceCriteria: Direct binary parser for GGUF v2/v3 header and key-value metadata
Extract general.architecture, context_length, embedding_length, block_count, head_count, head_count_kv
Extract tokenizer.chat_template and tokenizer.ggml.tokens without loading weights into RAM
Sub-millisecond metadata read time on models of any size

userStories.title: Jinja2 Chat Template Formatter & Generation Prompter
userStories.description: Format multi-turn conversation messages (system, user, assistant) into token-ready text prompts using extracted GGUF Jinja2 templates.
acceptanceCriteria: Jinja2 environment configured with standard filters and variables (messages, bos_token, eos_token, add_generation_prompt)

userStories.title: Single-Model Execution Engine & Streaming Output
userStories.description: Load GGUF model via llama_cpp with mmap, execute autoregressive decode, and stream tokens to stdout with real-time stats.
acceptanceCriteria: Stream tokens character-by-character / token-by-token to stdout with zero latency buffer
Calculate and display TTFT (Time To First Token), generation speed (tok/s), and memory consumption

Clean memory deallocation on exit

userStories.title: Unified CLI (pull, run, list, show, rm)
userStories.description: Provide a complete command-line interface mimicking Ollama commands for local GGUF management.
acceptanceCriteria: llmhub pull <spec> downloads and registers model
llmhub run <spec> executes model in chat REPL or one-shot prompt
llmhub list displays local models with size, quant, and parameter count
llmhub show <spec> displays detailed architecture metadata and memory estimation
llmhub rm <spec> deletes model file and cleans registry entry

userStories.title: Memory & Bandwidth Bound Physics Calculator
userStories.description: Mathematically compute exact weights size, KV cache memory footprint across context lengths, and theoretical memory-bandwidth bound generation ceilings.
acceptanceCriteria: Accurate KV cache byte formulas: 2 * n_layers * n_kv_heads * head_dim * ctx * element_size
DDR memory bandwidth bound calculation: max_tok_s = MemBandwidth / WeightsSize
Output explanation of memory-bandwidth bound decode vs compute-bound prefill

userStories.title: Deep Hardware Detection & SIMD/GPU Probing
userStories.description: Inspect CPU topology (physical vs logical cores, Big.LITTLE clusters), total & free RAM, SIMD extensions (AVX2, AVX512, NEON, SVE), and GPU acceleration presence across Windows, Linux, macOS, and Termux.
acceptanceCriteria: Accurately isolate physical cores from SMT hyperthreads across all OS
Detect ARM64 Big.LITTLE performance vs efficiency clusters
Detect SIMD vector instruction sets: AVX, AVX2, AVX512, FMA, NEON, SVE
Probe GPU accelerators (NVIDIA CUDA, Apple Metal, Vulkan) with safe fallback

userStories.title: Standardized Model Manifest Schema & Generator

Stores hardware profile requirements (min RAM, recommended threads, theoretical tok/s)

userStories.title: Heuristic Auto-Tuning Engine
userStories.description: Auto-select optimal threads (physical performance cores, strictly avoiding logical hyperthreads), dynamic context size based on free RAM safety margins, and quantization recommendations.
acceptanceCriteria: Thread selector strictly selects physical performance cores

acceptanceCriteria: llmhub hardware outputs detailed CPU topology, RAM, SIMD, and Termux constraints
